properties.name: BFR115
properties.notes: Emerging Local Plan Ref ST2-29 - The area of employment land on the northern portion of site should be retained; including the historic train-shed brick building on site. The southern end of the site is allocated for residential use. A landscaped buffer will be required to protect residential amenity and provide benefits to biodiversity adjacent to the railway. Access to employment land should be taken from the existing access on Station Approach. Access to residential development should be taken from Greenfield. Safety enhancements such as signing and lining are likely to be required at the junction of Greenfield and Forge Croft. Safe and convenient links should be made to the footpath network to the south of the site.
